d: Fairy garden in the Reiche Oberons, in lush blooming flowers. Oberon lies sleeping on the flower camp. Genies and fairies are grouped in a tableau, which moves until the beginning of the song only little. At the beginning of the choir the elves appear to show themselves united with the geniuses in various groups. All carry lily wreaths on their heads and hold lily stems in their hands
On a road from the magic forest of Oberons to Baghdad
An open hall in the harem of the caliph Harun al Raschid

A magnificent hall in the palace of Harun al Rashid in Baghdad. Harun al Rashid sits on his throne to stand the Babekan and the greats of the empire. Bodyguards are placed to the right and left to the side. In front of the throne, with crossed arms, servants
Poet garden behind the palace of the Kafifen
Short rock landscape. It's dark. Only Puck alone can be seen in it

Palace garden of the Emir Almansor to Tunis. Left front a bigger bush with a bench in front. Sunrise. Scherasmin digs and works as a gardener. The gardener's costume seems unnoticed at him and irritable to laugh. Fatime slowly comes from behind. A few steps before Scherasmin stops her; she too amuses the funny sight
Column hall in the palace of the Emir Almansor in Tunis. Rezia on a resting place in the foreground
